name: The Metal Knight
old_description: At The Metal Knight, we are dedicated to providing high-quality metal fabrication, repair, and welding services to businesses and individuals throughout the Treasure Valley. With years of experience in the industry and a commitment to excellence, we have earned a reputation as a trusted and reliable partner for all your metalworking needs.
about:
The Metal Knight operates from Boise, Idaho, serving businesses and individuals throughout the Treasure Valley. The company does not publicly state its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The shop provides in-shop welding services including MIG, TIG, and stick welding, along with metal repair for damaged machinery, tools, and equipment. It also offers custom metal fabrication, designing and manufacturing custom metal products ranging from single prototypes to larger production runs. CNC and laser machining capabilities allow precise cutting and shaping of materials such as steel and copper.

The company serves businesses and individuals across the Treasure Valley, with noted experience in the construction and automotive sectors, as well as custom commissions for various other industries.

The Metal Knight emphasizes experienced and skilled professionals, a commitment to quality and reliability, and competitive pricing with exceptional service. Because the shop is located in a residential neighborhood, appointments are required for visits.
type_evidence: We specialize in designing and manufacturing custom metal products for a wide range of industries, including construction, automotive, and customized commissions, whether you need a single prototype or a large production run, we have the skills and equipment necessary to deliver exceptional results.
